# Arenova — AI Automation Agency & Custom AI Agent Development

> Arenova is an enterprise AI automation agency and custom AI agent engineering company founded by Avi in Bengaluru, India, serving clients in India, the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, and Australia. Arenova designs deterministic workflow automation, autonomous multi-agent systems, and operations software around the tools teams already use.

## Core Services

- [AI Automation Agency & Services](https://arenova.in/services/ai-automation/): Production-grade workflow automation for inbound lead qualification, operational handoffs, and back-office pipelines.
- [Custom AI Agent Development](https://arenova.in/services/ai-agents/): Autonomous goal-directed agents with multi-step reasoning, scoped API tools, and zero-hallucination validation.
- [Business Process Automation](https://arenova.in/services/business-process-automation/): Connect ERP, CRM, billing, and databases into fault-tolerant automated processes.
- [AI Workflow Automation](https://arenova.in/services/ai-workflow-automation/): Resilient API microservices, unstructured document extraction, and dead-letter queues.
- [CRM Automation & Sales Systems](https://arenova.in/services/crm-automation/): HubSpot, Salesforce, and Zoho bi-directional synchronization, WhatsApp Cloud API, and outbound sales infrastructure.
- [Custom AI Development](https://arenova.in/services/custom-ai-development/): Bespoke LLM applications, private vector databases, fine-tuned open-source models, and full IP ownership.

## Industry Solutions

- [Real Estate AI Automation](https://arenova.in/industries/real-estate/): 24/7 WhatsApp & voice buyer qualification, showing bookings, and MLS CRM sync.
- [B2B Professional Services](https://arenova.in/industries/b2b-services/): Automated client onboarding, proposal triggers, and invoice reconciliation.
- [Healthcare Clinic Administration](https://arenova.in/industries/healthcare/): Patient appointment booking, administrative triage, and intake document collection.

## Interactive Tools & Pricing

- [AI Automation ROI & Cost Calculator](https://arenova.in/tools/automation-roi-calculator/): Calculate annual labor hours saved, dollar waste eliminated, and break-even payback period.
- [Pricing & Scope](https://arenova.in/pricing/): Transparent monthly retainers ($999/mo, $1,999/mo, $3,499/mo, and $490/mo front desk).
- [About Arenova](https://arenova.in/about/): Engineering principles, founder story (Avi in Bengaluru), and product ecosystem.

## Products

- [Arenova Frontdesk](https://frontdesk.arenova.in): Autonomous voice and WhatsApp inquiry triage and appointment booking.
- [Outreacher](https://outreacher.arenova.in): B2B outbound email and sales infrastructure.
- Arova Intelligence: Lead research, waterfall enrichment, and buyer prospecting software.
